description: A painting of several men panning for gold in a misty, wooded stream. In the foreground a man in a slouch hat and long coat kneels, holding a metal pan that shows bright gold flakes. Beside him a second man in a hat and waistcoat tends a wooden sluice box in the running water. Behind them many more men with shovels work among tall trees. Shovels and 19th-century dress are the era cues. No visible text, frame or gore; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
